world.name: More Room (MR)
world.author: micknerks
world.description: A sample day, given a place in your real room: cards on your desk, the calendar where a wall would be. Everything shown is invented. Its owner can connect it to a bridge on their own PC.

network.purpose: Lets the room's owner read their day (calendar, messages, tasks) from the bridge on their own PC, and send back presses.
